comments.author: amy-kwan
comments.body:
@lei137 This appears similar to the issue you are assigned to [powerpc64le: ICE during instruction selection](https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/issues/110753) for the missing `froundeven`.

It just looks like this is for `v4f32`.

issue.title: [PowerPC] fatal error: error in backend: Cannot select: t35: v4f32 = froundeven t34

tests.test_body:
define void @test(ptr %p1, ptr %p2) nounwind {
  %v = load <8 x double>, ptr %p1, align 64
  %res = call <8 x double> @llvm.roundeven.v8f64(<8 x double> %v)
  store <8 x double> %res, ptr %p2, align 64
  ret void
}

declare <8 x double> @llvm.roundeven.v8f64(<8 x double>)
